[web - flash] Tower of the Archmage - a simpler roguelike with a spell construction system, beatable in a day

Let's say you like the idea of roguelikes, but you don't like the thought of spending months or years playing a single game? It might take you a few tries, but you can beat Tower of the Archmage in a day. And what a good day it will be: TotA is a proper roguelike in every sense, just lacking some of the depth found in the heavy-hitters like Nethack. It has a great spell system involving the collection of runes and their combination into customizable spells, with unique runes to find and interesting possibilities involving summoning blocks and gasses. And some other things, later on.

The only negative I can say about TotA is that the inventory system gets cumbersome eventually, once you've built yourself up a stockpile of runes. This... really gets annoying, but you can manage it.

One thing - When you die, you get to carry over a portion of your runes to your next character. A small portion, but if you're carrying over late-game runes it really lets you blow through the early levels quickly. The thing is, the number of runes which you get to carry over depends on your progress in the game. Meaning that when you do that once and then kill yourself at an early level with that hugely overpowered AoE spell, you're going to be able to carry over fewer of those runes the second time. So, the lesson is: be careful with those AoEs.
